[[Super mutant (Fallout 76)|Super mutants]] |robots = |quests = |terminal = |cell name = |refid = }} The '''Summersville Lake''' is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in [[the Forest]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Layout== Before the [[Great War]], Summersville Lake was a reservoir created by the [[Summersville Dam]] on the [[Kanawha River]].''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]'' p. 335, Charleston: ''"Though you should make time to explore the north lakeside community of Summersville, and the shanty dwellings scattered across the deceptively dry Summersville Lake, you'll probably spend most of your time surveying the damage the city of Charleston suffered after the dam broke, sending the contents of the Kanawha River rushing through town (and that’s not counting the bomb damage)."'' In [[Timeline#2082|2082]], raider [[David Thorpe]] destroyed the dam, letting the reservoir flood through the nearby city of [[Charleston]] in what would be called [[the Christmas Flood]]. Summersville Lake subsequently became a dry lake bed. Near the center of the former lake is [[New Gad]], a post-War settlement constructed on the ruins of the town of Gad, which had been submerged by the reservoir.[[The Christmas Flood]]''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]'' p. 348, New Gad: ''"Before Summersville Lake was created, an old farming community set up a village named Gad. With the lake now 'drained,' a shanty town has appeared over the original town's foundations. It is a maze of tiny, interconnecting shacks. Learn to situate yourself by remembering the central 'Big Shack' has four levels and is in the center of town, with rickety planks out to other sections."'' The [[Lakeside Cabins]] sit on the north shore, [[overlook cabin]] on the east shore, the [[Summersville Docks]] on the west shore, and the destroyed Summersville Dam is to the south. Beside the wreckage of a sailed ship, a skeleton with a pistol has its feet encased in concrete, alluding to a mob-style murder that took place before the war. Another skeleton with hands and feet bound, tied to cinder blocks is found to the west. ==Appearances== The Summersville Lake appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Behind the scenes== * The [[Wikipedia:Summersville Lake|Summersville Lake]] is an actual reservoir in West Virginia created in [[Timeline#1960|1960]] with the construction of the real-world Summersville Dam. * Within the dry lake and east of the Lakeside Cabins, near a red boat, is a female skeleton lying on a door, reaching out to a partially-sunken arm from another skeleton. The scene is a [[Fallout 76 cultural references#Titanic|reference]] to the characters Rose and Jack from the 1997 film ''[[wikipedia:Titanic (1997 film)|Titanic]]''. ==Gallery== FO76 Misc lox 14.png FO76 Summersville Lake sign.png|Sign on the lake's northern shore FO76 New Gad skeleton scene 2.png|Unearthed murder victim FO76 New Gad skeleton scene 1.png|Second victim FO76 Misc lox 15.png|[[Anchor]] FO76 Summersville Lake Titanic.png|''Titanic'' reference ==References== {{references}} '''Non-game''' {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 unmarked locations]] [[Category:The Forest locations]] [[Category:Lakes]]

'''Tweed''' is a [[Protectron (Fallout 76)|Protectron]] serving as a [[Fallout 76 vendors|vendor]] at [[the Whitespring Resort]].

==Background==
Tweed is one of the dozen or so robotic vendors the Whitespring Resort replaced their human staff with shortly before the [[Great War]].<ref>[[The Whitespring 2080 Initiative]]</ref> He resides in the Bespoke store of the Whitespring mall area. He mainly sells a variety of formal wear.
